dialect.detail: Compuware Xpediter/TSO demo program (CWXTCOB), designed for IBM mainframe TSO/batch environment. Uses LINKAGE SECTION with PARMINFO, GOBACK, LABEL RECORDS, BLOCK CONTAINS, RECORDING MODE IS F, COMP-3, and 88-level condition names consistent with IBM Enterprise COBOL.
evidence: LINKAGE SECTION with PARM-LTH PIC S9(4) COMP
ASSIGN TO EMPFILE / RPTFILE (DD name style)

purpose.domain_detail: Compuware Xpediter/TSO training and debugging demo program processing employee wage/compensation data
purpose.summary: CWXTCOB is a Compuware Xpediter/TSO demo batch program that reads an employee file containing hourly, sales, and management records, calculates compensation (wages, overtime, commissions), stores results in a hold table organized by region, and prints an Employee Compensation Report and a Regional Sales Report. It is intentionally designed with known defects (S0C7 abends, table overflow) for use in debugger training sessions.

notable_features: Two-dimensional OCCURS table (HOLD-TABLE) with SET/indexed access
CALL to external subprograms CWXTSUBC (commission calc) and CWXTDATE (date/service calc)
COPY statements for EMPFILE, RPTEMP, RPTREGN copybooks
REDEFINES for date fields and region name table
Intentional error conditions documented in comments (S0C7, table overflow) for training purposes
verdict.notes: Source is truncated at 16000 chars (procedure division cut off mid-word 'PERFO'). Program is a well-known Compuware training artifact widely distributed with Xpediter/TSO. Fixed format confirmed by max_line_length=72 and no long lines. All four divisions present.
